ig_caption:
The pawns in front of your king are its front door. Three classic traps show what happens when one moves at the wrong time.

Fool's Mate: 1.f3 e5 2.g4?? Qh4 is checkmate. It is the quickest mate in chess.
Fishing Pole: in the Ruy Lopez, Black's knight sits on g4 as bait. 6.hxg4?? opens the h-file for Black's rook, and after ...Qh4 and ...g3, mate on h2 or h1 can't be stopped.
Siberian Trap: in the Smith-Morra Gambit, 9.h3?? is met by 9...Nd4! Take the knight or move the queen, and ...Qh2 is mate.

The habit that stops all three: before you push a pawn near your king, ask which squares it stops guarding.

Which of these have you fallen for? 👇

slides.title: One pawn move can lose.
slides.moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bb5 Nf6 O-O Ng4 h3 h5 hxg4 hxg4 Ne1 Qh4 f3 g3

slides.title: Fool's Mate
slides.take: White pushes the f- and g-pawns, opening the diagonal from h4 to the king. Black's queen gives mate at once.
slides.edge: It is the quickest mate in chess. Early on, keep the pawns next to your king at home.

slides.title: Fishing Pole
slides.moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bb5 Nf6 O-O Ng4 h3 h5 hxg4 hxg4 Ne1 Qh4 f3 g3
slides.take: Black's knight on g4 is bait. 6.hxg4?? takes it, but opens the h-file for Black's rook and queen.
slides.edge: After ...Qh4 and ...g3, mate on h2 or h1 can't be stopped. Leave the knight alone and keep the file shut.

slides.title: Siberian Trap
slides.moves: e4 c5 d4 cxd4 c3 dxc3 Nxc3 Nc6 Nf3 e6 Bc4 Qc7 O-O Nf6 Qe2 Ng4 h3 Nd4
slides.take: Black's queen and knight both aim at h2. White's knight on f3 guards it. 9.h3?? chases the knight, but 9...Nd4! hits the queen.
slides.edge: Take the knight on d4 and ...Qh2 is mate. Move the queen and ...Nxf3+ comes first, then ...Qh2 mate.

slides.title: Ask before a pawn moves
slides.body: Every pawn near your king guards squares. Before you push one, or take with one, ask which squares it stops guarding and which lines it opens.
slides.note: A pawn can never move back, so this check is worth a few seconds.
